ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximate 75:25 ratio of low-intensity black/dark-grey pixels to high-intensity white pixels concentrated on the distal margins.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Large contiguous high-intensity white patch on the upper-outer quadrant of the left lobe; dense white focal mottling and small circular clusters on the upper-outer quadrant of the right lobe; the central and interior regions are dominated by low-intensity black pixels.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped depression with a calculated angle of approximately 50 degrees and a significant bounding-box depth relative to the lobe height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrations across the entire span; a prominent large-amplitude V-shaped indentation is visible on the inner-half of the left trailing edge; the right trailing edge exhibits a series of smaller, sharper peak-and-valley variations.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex curvature on the lateral margins sweeping upward and outward to sharp distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Multiple circular high-contrast white clusters (3-5 pixels wide) detected on the lower-left interior surface and the extreme upper-right tip, consistent with sessile organism attachment points.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Several unaligned, thin linear pixel disruptions (rake marks) oriented diagonally from the trailing edge inward, most visible against the dark pigmentation of the right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Notable reddish-brown protruding tissue mass and loss of structural integrity on the extreme distal tip of the right lobe; deep irregular notch on the left trailing edge suggesting historical mechanical trauma.
other_distinctive_markers: Visible horizontal white striations or banding patterns near the insertion point of the fluke (peduncle area) where it meets the water line.
